'oder vergleichbaren Cloud-Technologien' names the broad cloud skill, so cloud is labeled alongside azure.
'vergleichbarer Fachrichtung' widens the degree field only, so degree_or_equivalent is false. 'abgeschlossenes Studium' names no level, so the degree is bachelor.
